name: easyquiz
description: Snip a question, get the answer next to your cursor. Browser extension powered by Groq.

scripts.lint: for f in *.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && web-ext lint --self-hosted --ignore-files 'dist/**' 'tests/**' 'docs/**' 'node_modules/**' 'build.sh' '*.md' 'package*.json'
